messages:
jordana: quick coordination q about streaming deltas and tool calls — wanting a short, unambiguous rule we can ship in the contract. two things: omission vs null for absent tool_call, and how to represent tentative tool suggestions mid-stream. cc @leah @nate

leah: prefer omission (no field) when there is no real tool invocation. fewer surprises for parsers and aligns with how we treat other optional props. clients should defensively treat missing and null equivalently but doc omission as preferred.

nate: okay on omission, but a lot of stricter consumers (old TS runtimes) currently expect shape to include tool_call sometimes. we should call out `tool_call?: ToolCall | null` in the SDK types and add a compatibility note.

jordana: second part: if model signals intent (UI should show a "suggested tool"), do we put a partial `tool_call` in an intermediate delta? example intermediate delta: ```{ "type":"delta","role":"assistant","tool_call": { "name":"kb_lookup","args":"{\"q\":\"account id\"}" }}``` then never actually execute.

leah: yes — intermediate deltas can include tentative tool info for UX, but it must be clearly transient. important invariant: the final `done` event must not fabricate an invocation. `tool_call` on `done` must only exist for executed calls.

nate: for marking tentative vs executed we have options: a) add `status: "suggested" | "executed"` to the tool_call object, b) include a separate lightweight field like `tentative: true` on the delta. both are workable but adding `status` keeps everything in one object.

jordana: either approach is fine — goal is unambiguous semantics. also want minimal churn for existing SDKs. if we add `status`, make it optional and default to `executed` when present on `done`.

leah: small compatibility caveat: prefer not to add required fields anywhere. everything must be optional so older clients don't break. document examples for three cases: 1) no tool interaction (no tool_call anywhere) 2) tentative suggestion (intermediate delta with `tool_call` + optional `status:"suggested"`) 3) executed call (final `delta` / `done` includes `tool_call` with `status:"executed"` and exec metadata).

ci-bot: smoke-tests queued (jordana) — ETA ~2h :package: 

nate: i'll open a tiny PR to relax strict deserializers (TS change) and add a unit test that consumes a stream with: suggested delta -> done with no tool_call -> assert no crash and suggestion cleared.

jordana: also propose an optional `stream_events` array on `done` for analytics/audit (e.g. record of suggestions that never executed). MUST be optional and never required for client behaviour. doc explicitly: "do not rely on `stream_events` for UI decisions; it is audit-only."

leah: agreeable. i'll draft the contract patch and include sample JSON for all three scenarios plus SDK guidance: `tool_call?: ToolCall | null` and runtime guards like `if (delta.tool_call?.name) { ... }`.

nate: thumbs up — i'll review once PR is posted. also will add a linter rule that flags any server-side code that emits `tool_call` on `done` when there is no execution record.

jordana: tldr i'll PR: 1) omit `tool_call` unless executed (prefer omission over null), 2) intermediate deltas may contain tentative tool signals (status optional), 3) `done` only contains `tool_call` for actual invocations, 4) optional `stream_events` for analytics, 5) SDKs should accept undefined/null and be defensive. PR coming in ~15m.

leah: thanks!
